title: The Universal Event Calendar
titleTail: : Every Seasonal Event at Both Resorts, Year at a Glance
h1: The Universal event calendar: every seasonal event at both resorts, month by month
description: A year-at-a-glance timeline of every recurring seasonal event at Universal Orlando and Universal Studios Hollywood, with each band labelled by confidence.
summary: Five recurring seasonal events run across the two US Universal resorts, and they leave a genuine hole in the middle of the year — from late spring to the middle of summer there is nothing seasonal on at either resort, which is a planning fact rather than an oversight.
notes: Bands are windows, not schedules. Each one describes the span an event has occupied across recent cycles, rounded to whole months. An event whose band covers a month may run on only a handful of nights within it, which is true of both Halloween Horror Nights bands for most of their run.

Two bands wrap the year. The holiday overlays at both resorts start in November and finish in the first days of January, encoded here as month 11 to month 1 rather than clamped to December, because clamping them would hide the reason the first days of January are worth knowing about.

The gap is the useful part. Nothing seasonal runs at either resort from the end of Mardi Gras until Halloween Horror Nights opens, which is roughly a third of the year. A trip in May, June or July is buying the parks and nothing else, and that is worth knowing before you pick dates for atmosphere.

Universal's calendar is unusually paid. Three of the five bands here are hard-ticket or evening events with a separate charge, against two overlays included with admission. That is close to the inverse of what visitors coming from the other Orlando resort expect, and it changes how a seasonal trip should be budgeted.

Every band is labelled expected rather than confirmed. Each event has held its window across recent cycles, which is strong enough to plan around, and none has dates we have verified against an operator calendar as of July 2026.

freshness.sourceNote: Each band describes the window an event has occupied across recent cycles at its resort, rounded to whole months, and matches the typical windows in this site's reference table. No current or future dates have been verified by us against either resort's published calendar as of July 2026, which is why every band carries the expected label rather than confirmed. Bands are rechecked as each season's dates are announced rather than once a year.
